The only guard activity recorded here is from that same message: the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The thread doesn't say more about the guard in between. The next entry is Mateo at 11:03 AM, reporting that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. You recorded both lanes working at 11:07 AM.
